newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close up, but off day's high.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close up, but off day's high.

text.p: * Index ends 25.82 points up, 0.82 percent, at 3,180.20
Late session profit-taking in Petron Corp and PLDT cut part of the early gains which had propelled the index up by over 50 points, brokers said.
The composite index ended up 25.82 points, or 0.82 percent, at 3,180.20.
"The initial spurt was because of the U.S. market but resistance eventually came in at 3,200," said Harry Liu, President, Summit Securities.
The Dow Jones shot up by 2 percent, or 126.87 points, to 6,473.64 pn Thursday boosting sentiment in the local market.
Brokers said it was the Dow's performance that pushed Manila share prices higher in a market that was otherwise expected to retreat slightly after Thursday's nearly 50 points rise.
Consumer stocks such as San Miguel Corp, Selecta and RFM Corp led gainers on expectations of a turnaround by the food and beverage sector in 1997.
Advancers beat decliners 68 to 51 with 71 issues unchanged. Value turnover was heavy at 3.327 billion pesos with volume at 5.127 billion shares.
The index pierced through the resistance level of 3,200 with its intraday high of 3,204.58 points achieved in midtrade.
Harry Liu, President, Summit Securities said the Christmas holidays would keep the market in a trading range next week, the last four trading days of the year.
